note: A15.8 baseline 2026-09-17: PARTIAL -- queue path full (extract 2/2, literal 2/2, route 1/1), one forbid violation (event_emit:publish from the producer's method declaration). The spec's 'Spring Kafka has zero needles, extract=0/2' predates A2.2. Aggregates with fixtures/xcut-queue-java-spring (full), so the cell drops full -> partial under the MIN rule. Generics `KafkaTemplate<String, String>` and `ConsumerRecord<String, String>` are written out for the later MESSAGE_TYPE work. Keyed on QUEUE_* + QUEUE_FLOWS like every A15.7 messaging cell, including the eventbus-first mechanisms (sqs_sns, azure_sb, redis, mqtt), so TypeScript/Java/C# read on the same scale as Python/Go and an EVENT_* key cannot flip to `none` when A2.9 moves broker pub/sub out of eventbus.rs. `via` still records the eventbus path when that is what fired.
